proof_review.degree_bound: For a=p-q-1, deg(R_E)<=8p-1 and deg(P_nu)=d give mp<=7p+d+q; the row identity d+q=p-r-2
proof_review.determinant: The observation matrix is unit lower triangular. Multiplication by A in F_p[Z]/Q^4 has norm Res(Q^4,A)=Res(Q,alpha+beta Z)^4=(alpha^2+beta^2)^4.
proof_review.reciprocity: B0 is reciprocal about degree 2p and P_nu is reciprocal because r is even; reflection about 4p+d maps a+mp to b+(3-m)p with b=p-r-1.
proof_review.joint_rank: On each length-four local factor, the intersection of multiplication kernels has dimension min(k0,k1), yielding the stated stacked rank formula.
proof_review.normalization_caveat: The eight-phase matrix is a canonical recurrence-module normalization after one Q factor; it is not asserted to be an unnormalized early-coefficient matrix or the older Item-233 matrix.
